mapper.select:
SELECT tpd.TRADE_ID, tpd.F_TRADE_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpda.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptrd.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION, ftp.BASIS, ftp.TRADE_MARKET, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, ftp.VDATE, ftp.MDATE, ftp.TERM, ftp.TERM_TYPE, ftp.CALENDAR_ID, tpd.CCY, ftp.PRIN, ftp.M_INT_AMT, ftp.M_TRADE_AMT, ftp.INT_RATE * 100 rebackPrice,
ftp.ACT_CAP_DAYS, ftp.VPAY_DATE, ftp.MPAY_DATE,
tpd.REMARK, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, TPD.CHL_ID, TPD.FEE_AMT, TPD.TRADE_AMT, fpt.TYPE_6,
tpd.branch, tpd.regist_org
,tpd.r_trade_id FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptrd ON ptrd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON tpd.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp ON (case when tpd.IS_OUT_TRADE='N' and tpd.R_TRADE_ID is not null then tpd.R_TRADE_ID else tpd.TRADE_ID end) = ftp.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON (case when tpd.IS_OUT_TRADE='N' and tpd.R_TRADE_ID is not null then tpd.R_TRADE_ID else tpd.TRADE_ID end) = fpt.FINPROD_ID
AND fpt.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} WHERE PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND tpd.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT
FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW WHERE TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} AND TRADE_ID != FINPROD_ID AND HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_04}
select max(TRADE_ID) from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId}

SELECT sum(NVL(INTOTALPRINAMT.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 * NVL(FSCR.SCALE, 0))- AVG(NVL(STANDARDPLEDGE.AMOUNT, 0)) PLEDGEPRINAMT FROM (SELECT PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PSP.FINPROD_ID, PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID, PSP.CCY, TO_CHAR(PSP.CDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') CDATE, SUM(NVL(PSP.AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON B.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID WHERE PSP.HODING_TYPE IN ('01', '03') AND PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND B.TRADE_PLACE in ( '03','04') AND PSP.CDATE = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PSP.FINPROD_ID, PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID, PSP.CCY, PSP.CDATE) AVA LEFT JOIN (SELECT TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID SEC_ACCT_ID, TPD.CCY, SUM(DECODE(TPD.PS, 'T23', NVL(TPD.PRIN_AMT, 0) * -1, NVL(TPD.PRIN_AMT, 0))) AMOUNT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPDA.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID WHERE FPT.TYPE_6 = 'H02' AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TPD.IS_CANCEL='N' AND TPD.PS IN ('T23', 'T01') AND TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F02' AND TPD.TRADE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, TPD.CCY) STANDARDPLEDGE ON STANDARDPLEDGE.SEC_ACCT_ID = AVA.SEC_ACCT_ID AND STANDARDPLEDGE.PORTFOLIO_ID = AVA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND STANDARDPLEDGE.CCY = AVA.CCY LEFT JOIN (SELECT TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID, SUM(NVL(PSPF.AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM TRD_STASEC_FLOW TSF LEFT JOIN TRD_STASEC_FLOW_DETAIL TSFD ON TSFD.SEQNO = TSF.SEQNO AND TSFD.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW PSPF ON TSF.SEQNO = PSPF.TRADE_ID AND PSPF.FINPROD_ID = tsfd.FINPROD_ID AND TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSPF.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSPF.SEC_ACCT_ID WHERE TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND TSF.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID) INTOTALPRINAMT ON INTOTALPRINAMT.PORTFOLIO_ID = AVA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND INTOTALPRINAMT.SEC_ACCT_ID = AVA.SEC_ACCT_ID AND INTOTALPRINAMT.FINPROD_ID = AVA.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO FSCR ON FSCR.FINPROD_ID = AVA.FINPROD_ID AND FSCR.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FSCR.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO FSCRINNER WHERE FSCRINNER.FINPROD_ID = FSCR.FINPROD_ID AND FSCRINNER.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FSCRINNER.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND FSCRINNER.VDATE > FSCR.VDATE)

select ORITRADEID id, ORITRADEID text from INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_REPO where 1=1 and PRODTYPE = #{prodType}
and ORITRADEID NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT F_TRADE_ID FROM ( SELECT T1.F_TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 WHERE T1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND F_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT T2.F_TRADE_ID FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 WHERE T2.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND T2.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND F_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL ) )
and ORITRADEID IN (#{initValue})
and ORITRADEID like concat(concat('%',#{param}),'%')

select T1.*,T2.CASHHOLDINGDAYS cashHoldingDays from INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_REPO T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY t.EXECID ORDER BY t.updatetime DESC)) rn FROM interf_cstp_trade t WHERE t.execid = #{fedealno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.businesstype = 'REPO') WHERE rn = 1 ) T2 ON T2.EXECID = T1.ORITRADEID where T1.ORITRADEID = #{fedealno}

SELECT fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, fp.FINPROD_ABBR bondAbbrName, fp.MDATE mdate, mbvi.NETPRICE firstNetPrice, fp.REGIST_ORG repRegistOrg, fpt.type_6 secType FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbvi ON mbvi.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND mbvi.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbviInner WHERE mbviInner.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE > mbvi.VALUE_DATE ) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON fp.FINPROD_ID = FPT.FINPROD_ID where fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_ZQ} and fp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

select t2.finprod_market_id bondCode, t2.finprod_id finprodId, t2.finprod_abbr bondAbbrName, t1.pledge_amt pledgePrin, null as prin, t1.pledge_ratio*100 pledgeRatio from fin_deal_pledge t1 left join fin_product t2 on t1.pledge_finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t1.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and t1.branch =#{branch}
SELECT B.FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_NAME FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finId}

SELECT SUM(qty) FROM ( SELECT fdt.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE qty FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_TARGET fdt on tpd.TRADE_ID = fdt.FINPROD_ID AND fdt.BRANCH = 0 INNER JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO WHERE fdt.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and tpd.finprod_type2 in ('F29') and to_date(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= tpd.TRADE_DATE and to_date(#{mdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= tpd.MDATE
union all
SELECT fdt.PLEDGE_NUMBER*100 qty FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE fdt on tpd.TRADE_ID = fdt.FINPROD_ID AND fdt.BRANCH = 0 INNER JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO WHERE fdt.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and tpd.finprod_type2 in ('F05') and to_date(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= tpd.TRADE_DATE and to_date(#{mdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= tpd.MDATE )

SELECT sum(NVL(ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_AMT, ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_NUM)- NVL(ETR_FINISH_STATUS_A.FINISH_AMT, 0)) proAvailableCash FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ON ETR_DISTRIBUTE.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ETR_FINISH_STATUS.ENTRUST_ID, sum(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) ETR_FINISH_STATUS_A ON ETR_FINISH_STATUS_A.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD ON ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID WHERE ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID IN
#{item}
select SEQNO, CSTP_TRADE_ID, PRE_TRADE_ID from TRD_MATCH_INFO where CSTP_TRADE_ID = #{CSTP_TRADE_ID} and PRE_TRADE_ID is not null
select CHL_ID from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.REGIST_ORG, T3.NETPRICE issuePrice
,(NVL(avaExt.AMOUNT, 0) - NVL(pledgeExt.AMOUNT, 0)) * 100 AS issueAmt
FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 left join ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID,T2.NETPRICE from MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 INNER join (SELECT T4.SEC_ID, MAX(T4.VALUE_DATE) VALUE_DATE FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T4 WHERE T4.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY SEC_ID) T5 ON T5.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T5.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) T3 ON T3.SEC_ID = T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID, SUM(DECODE(HODING_TYPE,'04',-AMOUNT,'06',-AMOUNT,'11',-AMOUNT,AMOUNT)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FPSAI ON PTL_SEC_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID = FPSAI.FINPROD_ID WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CDATE = TO_DATE(#{platDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND HODING_TYPE IN ( '03','04', '05','06','11','12') AND (FPSAI.FINPROD_ID is null or FPSAI.FINPROD_TYPE2 !='F28') GROUP BY PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID ) avaExt ON avaExt.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.FINPROD_ID, SUM(NVL(-AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FPSAI ON PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.SEC_ACCT_ID = FPSAI.FINPROD_ID WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{platDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND HODING_TYPE = '01' AND (FPSAI.FINPROD_ID is null or FPSAI.FINPROD_TYPE2 !='F28') GROUP BY PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.FINPROD_ID ) pledgeExt ON pledgeExt.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
where T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID in
#{item}

SELECT TRADEID TRADEID, PRODTYPE PRODTYPE, PS PS, CRTREVDEALSTATUS CRTREVDEALSTATUS, RETRADEID RETRADEID, MARKET MARKET, ISMANAUL ISMANAUL, ASSETPOOL ASSETPOOL, DEALDATE DEALDATE, VDATE VDATE, MDATE MDATE, TERM TERM, CCY CCY, REPORATE REPORATE, BASIS BASIS, REPOINTAMT REPOINTAMT, REPOAMT REPOAMT, SECID SECID, SECNAME SECNAME, FACETOTALAMT FACETOTALAMT, VCPRICE VCPRICE, MCPRICE MCPRICE, VDPRICE VDPRICE, MDPRICE MDPRICE, VYIELD VYIELD, MYIELD MYIELD, VINTEREST VINTEREST, MINTEREST MINTEREST, VDEALAMT VDEALAMT, MDEALAMT MDEALAMT, VCLRFORM VCLRFORM, MCLRFORM MCLRFORM, CLIENTTYPE CLIENTTYPE, BUYCOST BUYCOST, BUYTRADER BUYTRADER, SELLER SELLER, SELLCOST SELLCOST, SELLTRADER SELLTRADER, ASSETREFRATE ASSETREFRATE, ASSETAMT ASSETAMT, HOSTRATE HOSTRATE, HOSTAMT HOSTAMT, DEALNO DEALNO, MFLAG MFLAG, FMFLAG FMFLAG, CDATE CDATE, EFFECTFLAG EFFECTFLAG, INTDATERULE INTDATERULE, ISHEDGING ISHEDGING, ATTCH1DIR ATTCH1DIR, ATTCH2DIR ATTCH2DIR, ATTCH3DIR ATTCH3DIR, DEALTEXT DEALTEXT, CREATEUSER CREATEUSER, CREATEDATE CREATEDATE, LSTMNTUSER LSTMNTUSER, LSTMNTDATE LSTMNTDATE, REVDATE REVDATE, ORITRADEID ORITRADEID, OURDEPOSITACCOUNTNUMBER OURDEPOSITACCOUNTNUMBER, COUNTERTELEPHONE COUNTERTELEPHONE, TERM_TYPE TERM_TYPE, SETTLE_SPEED SETTLE_SPEED FROM INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_REPO where ORITRADEID = #{fTradeId}

SELECT T1.MATCH_NUM*100 facetotalamt , T2.SECID secid, T2.CONVRATE convrate, T3.FINPROD_ABBR secname, T3.REGIST_ORG repRegistOrg, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.PORTFOLIO_ID FROM TRD_PLEDGE_MATCH_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN INTERF_TRAD_REPOASST T2 ON T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = CONCAT('F01_', CONCAT(T2.SECID, '.IB')) AND T1.CSTP_TRADE_ID = T2.TRADEID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST T4 ON T4.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID where T1.CSTP_TRADE_ID = #{fedealno} and T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
